pairs.subject: translation-pipeline-topology
pairs.evidence: src/i18n/en.ts:1 The UI string catalog uses an object tree without per-string translation state, forcing key parity and fragment-splicing fallback over untranslated values.

techniques.evidence: src/i18n/catalog.ts:17 The UI catalog store deep-merges English over missing keys, creating fragment-level splicing forbidden by the standard.
docs/i18n/ui-ledger.json:21 The UI ledger gate enforces a numeric ratchet threshold of 1285 identical values rather than a committed per-key allowlist.
scripts/i18n/identical-values-lib.mjs:17 The report classifies whole non-translatable values but lacks the four durable exclusion vocabulary classes on keys.
src/stores/i18nStore.ts:43 Font families and per-language configurations are maintained in a separate store map rather than in the language registry.
